summary: Iteration 57 - Standalone Messages and Network Pages Testing. All features working correctly. Backend APIs (12/12 tests passed): GET /api/pro/messages/{user_id}, POST /api/pro/messages, POST /api/pro/messages/{id}/read, GET /api/registrations (directory fallback), GET /api/pro/connections/{id}, POST /api/pro/connect, GET /api/pro/connection-requests/{id}. Frontend UI tests passed: Messages page with header, search bar, conversations list, chat area, back button navigation. Network page with stats bar (41 pros, 10 countries), tabs (Decouvrir/Mes connexions), search bar, pro cards grid with 'Se connecter' buttons, profile modals, filters. Dashboard navigation to standalone pages works correctly.

minor.issue: Fixed - RegistrationResponse model had required fields that some legacy database records were missing. Made organization_name, country, email, phone, profile_type, stand_request, bio, language_preference, how_heard, status, show_in_catalog, created_at all Optional with defaults.

issues: Minor React hydration warning about <span> inside <select> - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: RegistrationResponse model now has all fields as Optional with defaults - handles legacy data gracefully
Messages page uses polling (8 second interval) for real-time updates
Network page falls back to /api/registrations if /api/pro/social/directory returns empty
Connection requests are auto-accepted (status: 'accepted') - may want to add pending state in future
Profile modal shows contact info only when connected - good privacy design
